''[[SP35|A 'Thank You' That Transcends Time]]'' (''[[Ash & Pikachu|A&P]]'') }} |} '''Solana''' (Japanese: '''ヒナタ''' ''Hinata'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon Ranger|Ranger series}}, and one of the [[player character]]s in [[Pokémon Ranger (video game)|the game of the same name]]. She has also made several appearances in {{aniseries|PTS}}. ==In the games== {{incomplete|section|Role in plot if not chosen as player}} Solana is the female player character in {{vg|Pokémon Ranger}}. However, she also has an involvement in the story if the player chooses to play as the [[Lunick|male character]]. She will have {{p|Plusle}} as her partner Pokémon, whether Solana is the main character or not. She is [[friend]]s with the male character and is usually seen working alongside him, and some of the other characters in the game suggest there is a romantic connection between them. ==Gallery== ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto; You should check it out for yourself."'' ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Solana anime AG.png|thumb|220px|Solana in ''Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire'']] [[File:Solana anime DP.png|thumb|220px|Solana in ''Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl'']] ===={{aniseries|RS}}==== Solana first appeared in ''[[AG155|The Green Guardian]]'' as a Rank 3 Ranger. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} encountered her when they detoured through a forest after discovering the [[Kanto Route 17|Cycling Road]] was closed. When {{AP|Pikachu}} ran off after hearing something, Solana ordered the group to go back, but she agreed to assist find Pikachu after receiving approval from the [[Ranger Union]]. Deeper in the forest, Solana called on three {{p|Linoone}} with her Capture Styler to {{m|Slash}} away the vines blocking their way, freeing {{TRT}} in the process. The group found Pikachu and an injured {{p|Celebi}}. After the group gained Celebi's trust and helped it recover, Team Rocket arrived with their [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]]. Solana helped rescue Celebi from the mecha while commanding her {{p|Plusle}} to use {{m|Thunder Wave}} on it. In ''[[AG171|Pokémon Ranger - Deoxys' Crisis! (Part 1)]]'', Solana received reports of a large geomagnetic disturbance in a mountainous area. She was preparing to go to a meteor crash site by herself when she came across Ash's group again, and she reluctantly allowed them to join her. Solana then found {{an|Deoxys}} at the end of the cave. Deoxys became a challenge for Solana to capture as it needed to be in its Normal Forme. {{MTR}} and {{an|Max}} then revealed Deoxys was in pain and were later transported to {{TP|Deoxys|another dimension|unnamed world}} by Deoxys. In ''[[AG172|Pokémon Ranger - Deoxys' Crisis! (Part 2)]]'', Solana contacted the Ranger Union, where she learned more about the geomagnetic disturbance. She and the others returned to the cave to rescue Max and Meowth, as well as heal Deoxys. With {{AP|Sceptile}}'s help, Solana was able to capture Deoxys with her Styler and heal it. The resulting drop in atmospheric pressure caused the meteorite to explode, though Deoxys defended everyone from the blast. Solana declared the mission to be complete after Deoxys left its dimension behind to explore the {{pkmn|world}}. Solana appeared in the opening [[Spurt!]], starting in ''[[AG173|All That Glitters is Not Golden]]''. She also briefly appeared in the opening sequence of ''[[M09|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea]]'', where she rescued several forest Pokémon and then put out a forest fire with the help of an {{p|Azurill}}, {{p|Marill}}, and {{p|Azumarill}}. ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== In ''[[DP071|Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! (Part 1)]]'', she appeared with a new uniform, and did not have her Plusle with her. She called [[Kellyn]] on his Styler while he was with Ash, {{an|Dawn}}, and {{an|Brock}}. Solana notified him that she and [[Officer Jenny]] were on a motorcycle finding the location of [[J]]'s hideout. In ''[[DP072|Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! (Part 2)]]'', Solana informed Kellyn that [[J's client (DP071)|one of J's clients]] had escaped. After the group found J and her client's henchmen, Solana and Officer Jenny arrived to deal with the client's henchmen while Ash and Kellyn went after the client himself. Solana caught a nearby {{p|Trapinch}} with her Capture Styler and trapped the client's henchmen and Pokémon with {{m|Rock Tomb}}. ===Character=== Solana is athletic and quick-thinking. She initially disliked getting civilians to help her on her missions, as seen when she refused to allow {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} to assist in her first appearances. However, in ''[[DP071|Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! Part 1]]'' and ''[[DP072|Part 2]]'', she recommended that [[Kellyn]] work alongside Ash and the others to save the [[Aura Sphere Riolu]]. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} ====Status unknown==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Solana |pkmn=Plusle |img=Solana Plusle.png |type1=Electric |epnum=AG155 |epname=The Green Guardian |vajp=Tomoe Hanba |vaen=Tomoe Hanba |desc={{p|Plusle}} was Solana's main Pokémon during ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]''. Romina Marroquín Payró ([[DP071]]-[[DP072]]) |pl=Monika Wierzbicka |he=ליאת הר לב ''Liat Har Lev'' }} ==In the manga== [[File:Solana PR.png|thumb|250px|Solana in Pokémon Ranger the Comic: Double Mission]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Solana is a major character in [[Pokémon Ranger the Comic: Double Mission]] as the co-worker of [[Lunick]]. ====''[[Pokémon Ranger the Comic: Double Mission]]''==== She first appears to contact [[Lunick]] after one of his missions to inform him that the Ranger Leaders, Spenser, Joel, and Elita have failed in their mission to capture a {{p|Deoxys}} and have been defeated. After the Ranger Leaders were taken back to be healed, Solana and Lunick review the battle from Joel's Capture Styler. Soon after, Professor Hastings arrives and gives the two Rangers the mission to finish what the Ranger Leaders had started and capture Deoxys. Solana and Lunick capture several Pokémon to prepare for their fight against Deoxys and go to [[Lyra Forest]] to confront it. Soon after, they are attacked by Deoxys who quickly changes form and runs into [[Krokka Tunnel]]. Fearing what would happen if Deoxys gets to [[Fall City]], Solana attempts to capture it, only for it to change form to dodge her Styler. They are quickly surrounded by the [[Go-Rock Quads]], Tiffany, Garret, Clyde, and Billy who have defeated the final Ranger Leader, Cameron, and taken the {{p|Manaphy}} Pokémon Egg he had found. The two release themselves from Deoxys's grip, and Solana goes after Tiffany, who had been sent to take the Egg to the Quads' secret hideout, leaving Lunick to face the other three alone. Solana follows Tiffany to the [[Sekra Range]] and combats her for possession of the Manaphy Egg. Due to Tiffany having a Super Styler, an upgraded Capture Styler that had its designs stolen from Professor Hastings, she has the advantage in the fight. However, Joel sends Solana a message about how to capture Deoxys, which she relays to Lunick by using [[Poké Assist]]s. The message is revealed to be "Normal", which gives Lunick the idea to destroy the other Super Stylers to force Deoxys back into its Normal Forme, allowing him to capture and free it. Solana then has Minun break Tiffany's Super Styler, defeating her and winning back the Manaphy Egg in the process. After the Quads retreat, Solana and Lunick take Cameron and the Egg back to Professor Hastings's lab. Due to Fiore not having Trainers, everyone decides to send the Manaphy Egg to the Sinnoh Region to find a proper Trainer to take care of it. Soon after, Solana and Lunick leave on another mission to stop a {{p|Grimer}} outbreak in the Fall City [[Waterworks]]. ====''[[Pokémon Ranger: The Comic – Shadows of Almia]]''==== Solona appears in a photo in [[PRV1]]. ===={{MangaArc|Platinum}}==== Solana, together with [[Lunick]] and [[Iyori]], is seen in a flashback in ''[[PS441|Alternate Dimension Showdown XI]]'' while {{adv|Looker}} gives the {{p|Manaphy}} {{pkmn|Egg}} to {{adv|Diamond}}. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Plusle 2}}{{TrainerPoké |pkmn=Plusle |trainer=Solana |gender=female |type1=Electric |img=Solana Plusle PR.png |epnum=PR1 |epname=Episode One |desc={{p|Plusle}} is Solana's {{ra|partner Pokémon}} and the counterpart to [[Lunick]]'s {{p|Minun}}. She was used to battle Tiffany and broke her Super Styler and defeated her. She is known to use the Discharge [[Poké Assist]].}} ====Pokémon controlled via the [[Capture Styler]]==== {{TrainerPoké |pkmn=Various |type1=Unknown |img=Lunick Solana Pokémon PR.png |epnum=PR2 |epname=Episode Two |desc=Solana captured a {{p|Wurmple}}, {{p|Phanpy}}, {{p|Swellow}}, {{p|Ekans}}, {{p|Gengar}}, {{p|Houndoom}}, and {{p|Graveler}} so that they can battle the [[Go-Rock Quads]] and their {{p|Deoxys}}. Solana cleverly used their [[Poké Assist]]'s in order to relay a message to Lunick about the secret to capturing Deoxys. They can use various [[Poké Assist]]s.}} ===Ash & Pikachu=== [[File:Solana AP.png|thumb|200px|Solana in Ash & Pikachu]] Solana appeared in ''[[SP35|A 'Thank You' That Transcends Time]]''. {{sectionstub}} ====Pokémon==== {| width="25%" |- | {{InactivePoké|Solana|Plusle|Solana Plusle AP.png|Electric|link=no}} |} ====Pokémon controlled via the [[Capture Styler]]==== {| width="25%" |- | {{InactivePoké|Solana|Linoone|Solana Linoone AP.png|Normal|link=no}} |} ====Befriended==== {| width="25%" |- | {{InactivePoké|Solana|Celebi|Solana Celebi AP.png|Psychic|Grass|link=no}} |} {{left clear}} ==Merchandise== Solana appears on the boxart for the "Pocket Monster Advance Generation Game of Life" board game. ==Trivia== * Solana's European Spanish name is a reference to the moon, rather than the sun like all her other names. This is most likely due to the fact that the deity after which she is named sounds similar to her English name. Lunick's Spanish name is likewise a reference to the sun. * The Pokémon Ranger 4 Piece Collector Pin Set at PokemonCenter.com calls Solana '''Hiromi''', possibly indicating a name from before "Hinata" was finalized.[https://web.archive.org/web/20061113185036/http://www.pokemoncenter.com/invt/4679&temp=productdescription PokémonCenter.com | Pokemon Ranger: 4 Piece Collector Pin Set] It is also the Japanese name of [[Lizabeth]] from ''[[M09|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea]]''. * [[Lunick]] and Solana share similarities with the [[Player character|player characters]] of [[Pokémon Sun and Moon|Pokémon Sun, Moon]], [[Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon]]: ** Both pairs of characters are named after the sun and moon. In {{vg|Pokémon Ranger}}, the female and male player characters are named after the sun and moon respectively, while the naming of the player characters of Sun and Moon is the other way around. *** In European Spanish, the gender name scheme matches between the player characters of both games, as both male characters are named after the sun and both female characters are named after the moon.
